name: Handshakes and pairs
definition: If everyone in a group of n shakes hands with everyone else, each person shakes n minus one hands, but every handshake involves two people, so the total is half of n times n minus one. The same shape counts games in a round robin and lines between points.
recognizeWhen: everyone shakes hands with everyone else
each team plays every other team once
how many lines join these points
how many pairs can be made from the group
misconceptions: I multiplied the number of people by the number of handshakes each and forgot to halve it.
I counted a person shaking their own hand.
I used the total number of people where I needed one fewer.
